This repository packages LYT ResearchOS, a prompt-first, evidence-grounded research-engineering Agent Skill. For non-trivial changes, read `.github/skills/research-os/SKILL.md` first. Keep repository-wide instructions concise and place detailed workflow rules inside the skill's protocol files. Preserve progressive disclosure: do not merge every protocol into `SKILL.md`. Do not weaken final-test governance, evidence labeling, provenance, or operational safety without an explicit methodology change. Do not pre-approve shell/bash tools in skill frontmatter unless explicitly requested. Never commit secrets or private project data. Behavioral changes should update `CHANGELOG.md`. Validate prompt/experiment/handoff templates with the standard-library-only linters when possible.
